body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on '2008 CES') -- <Visual News> E-detail revealed its new dual display touch screen tablet pc during CES 2008 Unveiled NY Press Preview. Designed for one-on-one presentation, it features two monitors - both supports touch screen functionality. It supports instant-on fast display feature to reduce booting time and the small monitor rotates 360-degree.

It is not just a dual monitor but a slim tablet pc offering full computer capability and the company is currently developing a portable slim keyboard, which is expected to be used as a cover to protect the large screen. A complete package of monitors and a keyboard will be demonstrated during CES 2008 in Las Vegas, USA in January, 2008.
